legitimate_revisit: A new Research Director allocation with explicit accounting. A different threshold, macro variable, regime count, smoothing, hysteresis, lag variant, feature set, label, barrier or horizon is not this experiment.
mechanism: Financial conditions may change how internal market descriptors map to forward net R. Two disjoint experts, selected hour by hour by a fixed zero-threshold point-in-time NFCI gate, may rank default-cost long opportunity quality better than one global weight vector; predictive, not causal.
